answer_1.quote: Developing agents capable of performing a wide spectrum of tasks across various environments at human-level has been a long-standing goal for AI community. Recently, large language models (LLMs) are considered a promising foundation for constructing such generalist agents due to their generalized abilities
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include actions and reasoning thoughts in ReAct format, such as 'Thought: I think I should search for pillows… Action: search[pillow]', and natural language responses in interactive environments.

answer_2.quote: We take the success rate as the evaluation metric and set the maximum round to 10.

answer_4.quote: For AGENTTRAJ, we annotate 400 trajectories of 18 out of all 40 tasks with commercial models. For AGENTTRAJ-L, we annotate 810 trajectories with commercial models. We take reward as the evaluation metric and set the maximum round to 20.
answer_4.guideline: The annotations are further refined by human review to ensure accuracy.
